app_delegate.query: MATCH (m:Method) WHERE m.name = 'application(_:didFinishLaunchingWithOptions:)' RETURN m.class, m.name, m.return_type

sha.query: MATCH (m:Method) WHERE m.name = 'computeSHA256Digest(_:)' RETURN m.class, m.parameter_types, m.return_type

c_types.query: MATCH (m:Method) WHERE m.name IN ['sqlite3_open16','mz_stream_read_uint16','WebPIsRGBMode'] RETURN m.name, m.parameter_types, m.return_type ORDER BY m.name

webp_fields.query: MATCH (f:Field) WHERE f.name IN ['bytes','size'] AND f.class = 'WebPData' RETURN f.class, f.name, f.type ORDER BY f.name
